lead: A `tainted bytes` value reaches only the `Neutral` members of `Core\Bytes`, because a `Contagious` parameter refuses `tainted` until taint propagation exists.
body: A received binary frame passed to `Core\Bytes::at`, `::slice` or `::unpack` is `E0401 expected bytes, found tainted bytes`, while `::length`, `::compare`, `::startsWith`, `::endsWith`, `::contains` and `::indexOf` take it. Write a proof over peer or request bytes with those, and spell an empty buffer `"" as bytes`: `bytes()` is not an expression.
